column1: # Heimish/Hasidic pronunciation overrides applied on top of the Phonikud-yi engine (data/phonemize.py).
# key = Hebrew-script word or multiword phrase (whitespace separated, punctuation stripped); value = IPA in the
# engine's closed inventory (vowels a aː ɛ ə i u ɔ ej aj ɔj oʊ; ˈ right before the stressed vowel).
# Sources: engine LOW/MED-confidence words reviewed by ear (Fable) for the scripts and the training corpus.
# Multiword keys win over single words (longest match first). Lines starting with # are comments.
# --- from reviewing the sukkah/tefillin scripts in context (the ReNikud context reader flips ɛ/ə and u/a on some words)
# --- from the corpus review (top ~220 LOW-confidence words, 2.8M tokens). Most misses: unpointed פ read as f in
#     loanwords/names (policy, computer, Putin), and loshn-koydesh vowels.
# --- corpus review, LOW words 221-420 and top MED words
# --- from Whisper on the first IPA renders: כ with dagesh in סוכה is k, the engine read it as x
# --- news line test (loanwords with unpointed א read as a instead of ɔ)
# --- Yiddish 24 website bulletin items (loanwords; the context reader also flips ɛ -> ə on many words)
